evidence.locator: L434-L468 (Other Features and Enhancements › Policy Report Enhancements › Custom Data in Reports)
evidence.excerpt:
#### Custom Data in Reports

A new field `reportProperties` is introduced to custom data in policy reports. For example, a validate rule below adds two additional entries operation and objName to the policy reports:

```yaml
apiVersion: kyverno.io/v1
kind: ClusterPolicy
metadata:
  name: require-owner
spec:
  background: false
  rules:
    - match:
        any:
          - resources:
              kinds:
                - Namespace
      name: check-owner
      context:
        - name: objName
          variable:
            jmesPath: request.object.metadata.name
      reportProperties:
      …
